title: Jesus... My Grandmother Didn't Know Who I Was Today
topic: grandmother with dementia no longer recognising him

bible.text: Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my grandmother didn't know who I was today. She called me by my uncle's name. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: She used to wait at the gate for me. Today she asked if I was the delivery boy.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: She forgot your name. She didn't forget the love she poured into you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What's the point of visiting if she won't even remember I came?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: She'll feel it, even if she can't hold onto it. And you'll remember it for both of you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I'm scared that next time she won't know anyone at all.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Maybe. But she's never been lost to Me. I know her name on the days she can't find yours.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Hold her hand anyway. Love doesn't need to be remembered to be real.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What's one thing your grandparents taught you that you still carry? 🙏
